$comment: Advisories we knowingly accept. Each needs a reason and an expiry; scripts/audit.ts fails once it lapses.

accepted.reason: Build-time only: @expo/cli validates app.json with it. Not in the app bundle, no untrusted input reaches it. No patched zod 3.x exists; npm's only fix is downgrading to Expo SDK 51.

Runtime, in URL parsing: a crafted link to the app could hang that tab (DoS, single user, no data exposure). The fix (0.5.1, 2026-10-23) is younger than our two-week rule and a major jump under query-string 7; re-test it as an override once it has aged.
Build-time only: merges our own app.json config. No untrusted input reaches it, no fixed release exists.
